summary: I found no declaration that an existing one directly replaces. Several proofs re-derive existing Mathlib combinators (`IsBaseChange.comp_equiv`, `local_hom_TFAE`), one new public wrapper has no consumer, and an old wrapper survives that should be inlined into its single caller.
